sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Receptor successfully purified in complex with NPY ligand and Gi1 heterotrimer, demonstrating intact ligand binding and G-protein coupling with the N-terminal FLAG tag in place.
sites.rationale: L2/L3 (PMC9067930) report a full-length, membrane-anchored Y1R construct carrying an exogenous HA signal peptide followed immediately by a FLAG tag at the receptor N-terminus; after HA-SP cleavage the FLAG is the first element before canonical M1, placing the junction at insert_after_residue=0. EC1 spans residues 1–44 and TM1 begins at residue 45, so the tag is ≥44 residues from any TM boundary. The receptor was purified as a functional NPY–Gi1 complex, confirming both surface trafficking and ligand/G-protein coupling are preserved. Full-length human Y1R expressed with an exogenous HA signal peptide and a FLAG epitope tag at the N-terminus, plus a C-terminal twin-strep-tag, in a modified pFastBac1 baculovirus vector; used to purify NPY-peptide-bound YR–Gi1 complexes from Sf9 insect cells.

sources.claim: The human Y 1 R, Y 2 R, and Y 4 R genes were cloned into a modified pFastBac1 vector (Invitrogen) with a HA signal peptide and a Flag tag at the N terminus, and a PreScission protease site followed by a twin-strep-tag (WSHPQFEK-GGGSGGGSGGSA-WSHPQFEK) at the C terminus.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Receptor expressed and purified from Sf9 membranes via anti-FLAG affinity; used for cryo-EM structure determination. Explicit functional assay (ligand binding, G-protein coupling) NOT MEASURED for this construct.
sites.rationale: L1 (PMC8844075) explicitly states the construct is Y1R residues 2–384 with a FLAG tag at its N-terminus, meaning M1 is absent and the FLAG is inserted between canonical positions 1 and 2 (insert_after_residue=1; residue_before=M, residue_after=N confirmed from the numbered sequence). EC1 spans 1–44 and TM1 begins at 45, so the junction is 43 residues from the TM boundary. This is a distinct junction from the L2/L3 prepend (insert_after_residue=0) and is reported separately per the two-junction rule. Validation is limited to detection by purification; no explicit surface or functional assay is described for this construct. Wild-type human Y1R construct spanning residues 2–384 (M1 omitted) engineered with a FLAG tag at its N-terminus and eGFP plus a cleavable His8 tag at its C-terminus; expressed in Sf9 insect cells using the Bac-to-Bac system for cryo-EM structural studies.

sources.claim: Wild-type human Y 1 R (2–384) with a FLAG tag at its N-terminus as well as eGFP and a His 8 tag at its C-terminus, cleavable by HRV 3C protease, was expressed in Spodoptera frugiperda (Sf9) insect cells using the Bac-to-Bac system (Invitrogen).

literature_notes: All six ledger lines were evaluated. L1 and L2/L3 both support N-terminal FLAG tags on full-length membrane-anchored Y1R but at slightly different junctions: L2/L3 use an exogenous HA signal peptide so the FLAG precedes canonical M1 (insert_after_residue=0), while L1 drops M1 and starts the construct at N2 so the FLAG sits between canonical positions 1 and 2 (insert_after_residue=1). Both are reported as separate sites per the two-junction rule. L4, L5, and L6 (PMC6751662) report eYFP fused C-terminally to human NPY receptors via an ADPPVV linker with confirmed plasma-membrane expression in HEK293 cells; however, the C-terminus of NPY1R is intracellular (IC4: 321–384), so this tag does not qualify as an extracellular surface site and is recorded in other_positions. L3 additionally specifies that C-terminal residues R341–I384 of Y1R were replaced with a twin-strep-tag; these residues are also intracellular (IC4) and are likewise recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports an insertion in any of the extracellular loops (EC2: 98–116, EC3: 176–211, EC4: 282–299).

literature_other_positions.note: eYFP fused C-terminally to human NPY receptor via ADPPVV linker with confirmed plasma-membrane expression; the C-terminus of NPY1R falls in IC4 (321–384) and is intracellular.
C-terminal residues R341–I384 of Y1R replaced with a twin-strep-tag for purification; residues 341–384 are entirely within IC4 (321–384) and the replacement junction (after F340) is intracellular.
